(() => {
  const result={};
  const properties=['user-select','-webkit-user-select','-moz-user-select','-ms-user-select'];
  const node=document.createElement('div');
  document.body.append(node);
  node.textContent='alpha beta';
  for(const property of properties){
    node.style.cssText='font:16px/20px serif;width:120px';
    node.style.setProperty(property,'none');
    result['grammar-'+property]=CSS.supports(property,'none') && !CSS.supports(property,'12px');
    node.style.setProperty(property,'12px');
    result['retained-'+property]=node.style.getPropertyValue(property)==='none' && node.getBoundingClientRect().height===20;
    result['removed-'+property]=node.style.removeProperty(property)==='none' && node.style.getPropertyValue(property)==='';
  }
  node.style.cssText='font:16px/20px serif;width:120px;-ms-transform:rotate(10deg)';
  try{node.getBoundingClientRect();result.transform=false;}
  catch(error){result.transform=error.message.includes('layout unsupported: -ms-transform');}
  node.style.cssText='font:16px/20px serif;width:120px;-example-user-select:none';
  result.unknown=node.style.getPropertyValue('-example-user-select')==='' && node.getBoundingClientRect().width===120;
  node.style.setProperty('-MS-USER-SELECT','none');
  result.case=node.style.getPropertyValue('-ms-user-select')==='none' && node.getBoundingClientRect().width===120;
  node.textContent='alpha beta';
  result.recovery=node.getBoundingClientRect().height===20;
  node.remove();
  return result;
})()
